title: Share your drop
summary: Your drop only works if people see it. Here's where to put your link.

steps.title: Open your drop
steps.body: Go to Drops and tap your running drop. "Share your drop" is near the top.

steps.title: Copy the right link for each place
steps.body: There's a link for each place you share: WhatsApp status, Instagram, QR code, your website and ads. Use the matching link in each place, and your results show which one brings people in.

steps.title: Post the images
steps.body: Under "Images to post" there's a WhatsApp status picture and a square post for Instagram. Save them, post them, and put your link in the caption.

steps.title: Put up your poster
steps.body: Drop links stop working when the drop ends. For your counter or door, print your poster instead: it always opens whatever you're running.

tips: Post on your WhatsApp status on the first day, then again when Tikkas are running low.
